score.about: Your DropRank score (/100) rates how ready this wallet is for a Base airdrop — from the breakdown below (transactions, active months, activity spread, volume, contracts, protocol diversity, bridge, identity, quests). Inspired by published airdrop criteria (Arbitrum, Optimism), it also flags sybil patterns (burst, dust). It's our own transparent score, computed differently from base.org's Onchain Score (Coinbase, proprietary) — so the two numbers differ.
